import { expect } from "chai"; import { html, signal } from "https://esm.sh/uhtml"; import AutoLoader from '../src/index.ts'; class BaseComp extends HTMLElement { connectedCallback() { this.setAttribute('data-upgraded', 'true'); this.appendChild(this.render()) } render() { return html`Hello World`; } }; class ErrorFallback extends HTMLElement { connectedCallback() { this.appendChild(this.render()); } render() { return html`

Fallback content

`; } } customElements.define('error-fallback', ErrorFallback); // Component catalog const catalog = { "test-component": async () => { customElements.define('test-component', BaseComp); }, "nested-component": async () => { class NestedComponent extends BaseComp { }; customElements.define('nested-component', NestedComponent); }, "dynamic-component": async () => { class DynamicComponent extends BaseComp { }; customElements.define('dynamic-component', DynamicComponent); }, "manual-component": async () => { class ManualComponent extends BaseComp { }; customElements.define('manual-component', ManualComponent); }, "interaction-component": async () => { class InteractionComponent extends BaseComp { }; customElements.define('interaction-component', InteractionComponent); }, "visible-component": async () => { class VisibleComponent extends BaseComp { }; customElements.define('visible-component', VisibleComponent); }, "error-component": async () => { throw new Error("Failed to load component"); } }; describe('CEAutoLoader', () => { let registry; const fixtures = document.getElementById('fixtures'); beforeEach(() => { fixtures.innerHTML = ''; // Reset observers, but we can't really unregister the custom elements. registry?.clean(); registry = undefined; }); it('should upgrade existing components on start', async () => { const el = document.createElement('test-component'); fixtures.appendChild(el); registry = new AutoLoader({ catalog, root: fixtures, }); await customElements.whenDefined("test-component"); expect(el.hasAttribute('data-upgraded')).to.be.true; }); it('should upgrade nested components', async () => { const container = document.createElement('div'); const el = document.createElement('nested-component'); container.appendChild(el); fixtures.appendChild(container); registry = new AutoLoader({ catalog, root: fixtures, }); await customElements.whenDefined("nested-component"); expect(el.hasAttribute('data-upgraded')).to.be.true; }); it('should upgrade dynamically added components (MutationObserver)', async () => { registry = new AutoLoader({ catalog, root: fixtures, observe: true }); const el = document.createElement('dynamic-component'); fixtures.appendChild(el); // Wait for MutationObserver and async hydration await customElements.whenDefined("dynamic-component"); expect(el.hasAttribute('data-upgraded')).to.be.true; }); describe("loading attribute", () => { it("eager", async () => { const el = document.createElement('test-component') el.setAttribute('loading', 'eager'); fixtures.appendChild(el); registry = new AutoLoader({ catalog, root: fixtures, observe: false, }); await customElements.whenDefined("test-component"); expect(el.hasAttribute('data-upgraded')).to.be.true; }) it('manual', async () => { const el = document.createElement('manual-component') el.setAttribute('loading', 'manual'); fixtures.appendChild(el); registry = new AutoLoader({ catalog, root: fixtures, observe: false, }); expect(el.hasAttribute('data-upgraded')).to.be.false; await registry.upgrade("manual"); expect(el.hasAttribute('data-upgraded')).to.be.true; }); it('click', async () => { const el = document.createElement('interaction-component') el.setAttribute('loading', 'click'); fixtures.appendChild(el); registry = new AutoLoader({ catalog, root: fixtures, }); expect(el.hasAttribute('data-upgraded')).to.be.false; await el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click')); await customElements.whenDefined("interaction-component"); expect(el.hasAttribute('data-upgraded')).to.be.true; }); it('visible', async () => { const el = document.createElement('visible-component') el.setAttribute('loading', 'visible'); fixtures.appendChild(el); registry = new AutoLoader({ catalog, root: fixtures, observe: false, }); expect(el.hasAttribute('data-upgraded')).to.be.false; await customElements.whenDefined("visible-component"); expect(el.hasAttribute('data-upgraded')).to.be.true; }); }); describe("Errors", () => { it("should handle errors in component definition", async () => { fixtures.appendChild(document.createElement('error-component')); registry = new AutoLoader({ catalog: catalog, root: fixtures, }); await new Promise(requestIdleCallback); const el = document.querySelector('error-component'); expect(el.getAttribute("ce")).to.equal("error"); expect(el.getAttribute("error")).to.include("Failed to load component"); }); it("Should allow a fallback component", async () => { fixtures.appendChild(document.createElement('error-component')); registry = new AutoLoader({ catalog: catalog, root: fixtures, fallback: ErrorFallback }); await new Promise(requestIdleCallback); await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); // Wait for fallback to render const el = document.querySelector('error-component'); expect(el.querySelector('error-fallback')).to.exist; expect(el.textContent).to.equal("Fallback content"); }) }) }); const runner = mocha.run(); runner.on('end', () => { window.__MOCHA_DONE__ = true; window.__MOCHA_STATS__ = runner.stats; });
